clue.text: Stay to the end and bid farewell to guests at the door

definitions.meaning: to remain until something has finished

definitions.text: bid farewell to guests at the door
definitions.meaning: to escort departing visitors from the house

explanation.surface: A host who lingers to the last and waves visitors off at the door.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both lasting until a finish and accompanying departing visitors out.

clue.text: Caught young seaman boxing

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a rating is a junior, non-commissioned sailor in the navy

explanation.surface: A young sailor is caught taking part in a boxing bout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxing' pretends to be the sport but means packing goods into crates.
explanation.definitionFit: Packing goods into wooden cases for shipment is a kind of boxing.

clue.text: Send off with a wave of the hand

definitions.text: Send off with a wave of the hand

parts.words: Send off with a wave of the hand
parts.note: sounds like a farewell gesture, but 'send off' means send to sleep, done by a mesmerist's passes of the hand

explanation.surface: Someone dismissed or waved goodbye with a flick of the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesmerist induces a trance, sending the subject off to sleep with hand passes.

clue.text: Old Margaret was given grub

parts.note: Mag is an old-fashioned pet form of the name Margaret
got means received, was given

explanation.surface: Elderly Margaret was handed some food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grub' looks like food but is the insect larva.
explanation.definitionFit: A maggot is the legless larva of a fly, and a grub is such a larva.

clue.text: Canoe in which a soldier finds shelter

definitions.meaning: a boat hollowed from a single tree trunk

definitions.text: in which a soldier finds shelter
definitions.meaning: a roofed trench or pit dug for protection in war

explanation.surface: A soldier takes cover inside a canoe.
explanation.definitionFit: The term covers both a boat hollowed from a log and a dug trench shelter used by troops.

clue.text: Protracted treatment of decayed tooth was performed

definitions.meaning: dragged on, lasting too long

definitions.text: treatment of decayed tooth was performed
definitions.meaning: a dentist pulling a bad tooth has extracted it

explanation.surface: A dentist's lengthy session dealing with a rotten tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: Prolonged means lengthened in time; an extracted tooth has literally been pulled from the gum.

clue.text: Cricketer renowned for great elegance

definitions.meaning: W. G. ..., the famous bearded Victorian English batsman
smooth refinement and poise of movement

explanation.surface: A batsman celebrated for his stylish play.
explanation.definitionFit: W. G. Grace was England's most famous Victorian cricketer, and refined poise of movement is called by the same word.

clue.text: Tunnel work is in progress

definitions.meaning: a tunnel is literally a road or passage running beneath
already started and continuing

explanation.surface: Excavation of a tunnel has begun.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase is a passage beneath the ground; as an idiom it means a task has started.

clue.text: Pithecanthropus is no lie-abed

definitions.meaning: an extinct primitive human, the Java ape-man
someone who rises promptly at dawn

explanation.surface: An ape-man described as an early riser.
explanation.definitionFit: Prehistoric humans are called by this phrase, which can also be read as a male who gets up at dawn.

clue.text: Miracle town has ways which lead to rumours

parts.note: Cana in Galilee, where Jesus turned water into wine
RDS is the abbreviation for roads

explanation.surface: Roads from a Biblical town where miracles happened carry gossip along them.
explanation.definitionFit: False stories spread as hoaxes are called by this French-derived word.

clue.text: Net Foreign Office turned to frequently

indicators.note: turned signals that both words, net and the Foreign Office abbreviation, are read backwards as one run

parts.note: taken as written; that the reversed run also begins the words Net Foreign is a coincidence, since Foreign Office is meant as its abbreviation
FO is the abbreviation for the British Foreign Office

explanation.surface: Diplomats repeatedly consult a fishing net, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: Many times over, repeatedly, is a synonym of the definition.

clue.text: Tell all about modern form of cardiac surgery

definitions.meaning: to reveal one's innermost feelings frankly
an operation in which the chest is opened and the heart exposed

explanation.surface: A patient confesses everything about a heart operation.
explanation.definitionFit: Opening one's heart is idiom for confiding everything, and it also names surgery with the chest laid open.

clue.text: Final comment I added to a Greek letter

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a comment added at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Someone adds a last note to a letter written in Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' suggests correspondence, which suits PS, but it is an alphabet symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the twenty-third character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Little nips or little nippers

definitions.meaning: very small drinks or tots of spirit
very young children

explanation.surface: Small drinks, or small children.
explanation.definitionFit: A tot is both a dram of spirits and a small child, so the phrase serves for tiny drams and for toddlers.

clue.text: Oust former member sought by newly recognised state

definitions.meaning: to remove a politician from a seat, leaving an ex-member
a new nation applies for a place at the United Nations

explanation.surface: A politician is thrown out while a new country seeks recognition.
explanation.definitionFit: To depose an elected member is the verb; read as two words it is a place in the United Nations that a new country wants.

clue.text: Doesn't matter if it is always matter

definitions.meaning: an expression telling someone to forget it
something that is always physical substance can at no time be intellect

explanation.surface: A philosophical shrug about the nature of matter.
explanation.walkthrough: It plays on the old joke 'What is mind? No matter. What is matter? ...'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase dismisses a concern; literally, anything always physical substance is at no time a thinking intellect.

clue.text: Mimics what a fighter squadron does when scrambled

definitions.meaning: imitates someone for comic effect

definitions.text: what a fighter squadron does when scrambled
definitions.meaning: aircraft ordered up in a hurry leave the runway and become airborne

explanation.surface: An impressionist imitates an air force squadron leaving in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both parodying someone and lifting off into the air.

clue.text: South Pennsylvania resort

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Pennsylvania

explanation.surface: A holiday destination in the south of Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: A town with mineral springs where people go for health is a type of resort.

clue.text: Umpire steps outside to make introductions

indicators.note: outside means the word for steps is placed around the word for umpire

parts.note: paces are steps
a ref, referee, is an umpire

explanation.surface: An umpire walks off the pitch to introduce the players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'steps outside' looks like an umpire walking off the field, but the two words split: the first is the outer word, the second says it surrounds the umpire.
explanation.definitionFit: Introductory sections at the front of books are synonyms of introductions.

clue.text: Consumed by a spirit of blind vengeance

definitions.meaning: eaten up
..., the Greek goddess of reckless ruin and retribution

explanation.surface: Someone devoured by a blind desire for revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of eat means consumed; Ate is also the Greek goddess personifying rash folly and vengeance.

clue.text: Pace at which a horseman is unable to hesitate

parts.note: can't means is unable
er is the sound people make when they hesitate

explanation.surface: A rider who cannot pause, kept going at a steady speed.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider moves his horse at this three-beat gait, slower than a gallop.

clue.text: Front and rear carriage of a train

definitions.meaning: the leading part, as in vanguard
the guard's wagon at the back of a train

explanation.surface: The carriages at either end of a train.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a short form of vanguard, the leading position, and also the guard's wagon at the back.

clue.text: Invites to pay a visit

definitions.meaning: asks someone formally to speak or act
goes to see someone

explanation.surface: Someone extends an invitation to drop round.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both formally asking someone to speak and dropping in to see them.

clue.text: Last to finish despite everything

definitions.meaning: coming behind every other runner
in spite of what has been said, nevertheless

explanation.surface: Finishing last in spite of every effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase is behind everyone; as an idiom it means nonetheless.

clue.text: Taking it easy by standing on one's head?

definitions.meaning: relaxing, resting with legs raised
in a headstand the legs point skyward

explanation.surface: Relaxing by doing a headstand, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means resting with legs raised; in a headstand the lower limbs are literally aloft.

clue.text: Telling tales about a normal method of egg production

indicators.note: about means the word for telling tales surrounds the letter A

parts.note: lying is telling untruths, telling tales

explanation.surface: Fibs told about how hens normally produce eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Telling tales' suggests telling on someone, but here means telling lies.
explanation.definitionFit: Hens produce eggs by depositing them, which is what the gerund describes.

clue.text: Severe penalty for a brawny thug in good condition

parts.note: a heavy is a muscular hired thug
fine means in good health or condition

explanation.surface: A muscular thug in fine fettle receives a stiff punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A large monetary penalty imposed by a court is a severe one.

clue.text: Was his science fiction never translated?

definitions.text: Was his science fiction never translated?

indicators.note: translated suggests rendering into another language, here signalling that the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a sci-fi author's novels were ever rendered into other languages.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition and the wordplay: NEVER rearranged gives the French author's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Jules Verne was the French pioneer of science fiction, author of Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea.

clue.text: Oriental composes a ballad to mother

indicators.note: to means the ballad's word is attached after the word for mother

parts.note: ma is mother
a lay is a ballad or narrative song

explanation.surface: An Eastern songwriter writes a ballad dedicated to his mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Malaysia or the Malay peninsula is an Asian, an oriental in old crossword usage.

clue.text: Right to discipline an unruly child

definitions.meaning: accurate, without error
to punish a badly behaved youngster

explanation.surface: Is it proper to punish a misbehaving child?
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means accurate; the verb means to punish in order to reform behaviour.

clue.text: Refuse to lower the volume

definitions.meaning: to decline an offer
to reduce the loudness of a radio

explanation.surface: Declining to make the music quieter.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to reject an offer, and also to rotate a dial to reduce loudness.

clue.text: Faster revision is needed for the final course

indicators.note: revision suggests reworking, signalling that these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hurrying through revision before a final course of study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'final course' suggests education, but means pudding, the British informal word for dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for dessert, the course served last at a meal.
